content:
The leaf is entirely yellowed/tan-brown with tissue necrosis, small dark spots/lesions scattered across the blade, and some irregular brown patches along the margins. No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew), no black sooty surface (rules out Sooty_Mould), no distinct tip/shoot dieback pattern (rules out Die_Back). The scattered dark necrotic lesions with tan-brown leaf background are consistent with Anthracnose infection.
